title: Glowing kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5c8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tailGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4ee1ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8affc1'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 72 Q46 84 40 96' stroke='#9be8ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kite diamond -->
  <polygon points='50,8 78,40 50,72 22,40' fill='url(#kiteGrad)' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- cross spar -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='40' x2='78' y2='40' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner glow diamond -->
  <polygon points='50,22 66,40 50,58 34,40' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- bow tails -->
  <polygon points='42,80 46,74 50,80 46,86' fill='url(#tailGrad)' stroke='#b8fff0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='36,90 40,84 44,90 40,96' fill='url(#tailGrad)' stroke='#b8fff0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#fff6c9'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='26' r='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='58' r='2' fill='#c9f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='62' r='1.8' fill='#fff6c9'/>
</svg>
